# 06 — Hollows & Sower Constructs

The Hollow bestiary and the Sower constructs. **Style rules:** horror through wrongness, not gore; Bloom growth replaces blood; bodies burst into spores, not viscera. Hollows are *converted* from survivor-kit bodies, so any adult body and outfit combination can become a Hollow. **There are no child Hollows** (game bible 17 §17.8).

**13 entries · 18 Blender assets.** Standards: [00 — Character Art & Blender Standards](00-character-art-standards.md) · skeletons and facial sets: [10 — Skeletons, Rigging & Facial](10-skeletons-rigging-and-facial.md).

### HOL-001 · Shambler

`char.hol.shambler` · **Tier** Enemy · **Size** 1.75 m tall

> The common Hollow: slow, relentless, groups up, knocks on doors.

**Appears:** M0.02 (Dana Marsh)

**Gameplay**

| HP | Speed (m/s) | Damage | Infection / hit | Counter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 1.1 | 12 | 6% | Melee, headshots, chokepoints |

**Visual design**

- **Silhouette:** A person, almost: head tilted too far, shoulders uneven, one arm hanging.
- **Bloom growth:** Green veins under grey skin; lichen crust at the collar and hands; one fist-sized Bloom node on the head or chest.
- **Weak points:** Bloom node (×3 damage): SOCKET_BloomNode on head or spine_04, placed per variant.
- **Acting & movement:** Asymmetric shuffle set (6 variants), door-knock idle, lunge-grab, stumble recovery.
- **Audio:** Wet breath, radio-like clicks in the Verdance five-note rhythm.

**Wardrobe**

|---|---|---|---|---|
